name: Koihana Bakumeiroku
source:
The end of the Boshin War marked the beginning of the Meiji era.
You had no recollection of your early childhood, and since your foster parents have passed, you departed alone for the newly established capital - Tokyo. While you were taking in the beautiful townscape, you got dragged into some trouble, and as you pulled out your sword - a family keepsake - a man appeared. Once captain of the Shinsengumi's third division, currently in charge of the government's Battou unit - Saitou Hajime.

"That stance... are you with the Aizu? That would explain the sharp look in your eyes." 

From that meeting onwards, you started engaging with the Meiji government regularly, and while bonding with Kido Takayoshi and Katsu Kaishuu, you learned of Shikabito - the beings terrorizing the government. While pursuing leads on the Shikabito, you were faced with the Tokugawa shogunate's army, led by Ii Naosuke. Alongside him stood none other than ex-Shinsengumi Hijikata Toshizou. With the Meiji government-established army, under Saigou Takamori's command, there were now three forces facing off against each other.

"Even if I die here... I will find a way to walk with you again. ...You are my destiny."

As you put your life on the line, in the heat of the war, your love for him will bloom...
Will you live or die? This is where the story of your love begins!

[Translated from [url=https://p-one.site/bakumeiroku]official website[/url]]
translation:
戊辰战争结束，明治时代由此开启。

你不记得幼年时的经历，养父母去世后，便独自前往新成立的首都东京。欣赏美丽的街景时，你被卷入一场骚乱，拔出祖传的佩刀。一名男子随即现身——他曾是新选组第三队队长，如今负责政府的拔刀队。他就是斋藤一。

“这架势……你是会津那边的人吗？难怪眼神如此锐利。”

从那次相遇开始，你频繁与明治政府打交道，并在与木户孝允、胜海舟相识的过程中，得知了正在威胁政府的“死尸”一事。追查“死尸”的线索时，你又遭遇了井伊直弼率领的德川幕府军。他身旁站着的，竟是前新选组成员土方岁三。此时，西乡隆盛率领明治政府组建的军队也加入其中，三股势力就此对峙。

“即使我会死在这里……我也一定会设法再次与你同行……你就是我的命定之人。”

当你在战火中赌上性命，与他的爱情也将绽放……
你会生存还是死去？你们的爱情故事，就此展开！
